newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IDC to sell entire Sasol stake - report.
newsitem.headline: IDC to sell entire Sasol stake - report.

text.p: South Africa's state-owned Industrial Development Corp (IDC) plans to sell its entire remaining stake of 10 percent in synthetic fuel producer Sasol Ltd over the next three to five years, Business Day said on Wednesday.

But IDC chief executive Khaya Ngqula told the paper in an interview during an Edinburgh conference that the organisation had decided to retain its 16 percent stake in Iscor Ltd, worth about eight billion rand.

Ngqula said the Sasol sale ought to raise three billion rand for new investments. The IDC has already sold some of its shares to fund its $125 million investment in the Mozal aluminium smelter which Gencor Ltd is planning to build in conjunction with the IDC near the Mozambican capital Maputo.
The IDC considered Sasol a mature company which no longer needed its support, in contrast to steel producer Iscor where consideration was being given to extending investment, Ngqula said.
